messages:
sales-jordan: Heads-up — BrightBank POC starts load test in ~30m and they just hit a flurry of 503s in demo environment. Demo scheduled for 16:00 UTC, we need quick triage. Requesting support swarm.

support-elaine: Thanks Jordan — can you paste a couple of failing request_ids and approximate qps/concurrency? Also which model variant and region?

sales-jordan: reqs: rb-9f2a4c / rb-9f2a5d / rb-9f2a78. They were testing with 20 concurrent connections, streaming chat, model: redwood-alpha-4k, region: us-west.

oncall-bot: Alert: 503 surge detected for account=brightbank, service=hosted-inference-us-west, window=60s, p50_latency=120ms, errors=18 (threshold=5).

eng-jun: Quick read from logs — looks like capacity_throttle on burstpool. Snippet: ```[2026-03-21T15:29:21Z] serving/runtime: request_id=rb-9f2a4c status=503 error="capacity_throttle" pool=burstpool-us-west queued_ms=1175 active_gpus=12 max_gpus=12``` Also seeing intermittent kv-cache pressure warnings.

nina: Autoscale lag + burstpool exhausted. Policy currently: min=2 nodes, max=12, scale_cooldown=90s, scale_step=2. Under sudden ramp we hit max before new nodes in. Two immediate options: 1) spillover routing to us-east, or 2) route to a lower-capacity variant (redwood-alpha-2k-quant) for demo.

ava: For a quick mitigation (demo in 30m) we recommended: - temporarily drop client concurrency from 20 -> 6 - set client retries with exponential jitter (max 3) - flip routing to model variant with half the memory (2k quant)

support-elaine: Jordan, can you ask BrightBank to reduce concurrent streams to 6 and enable client-side retries? We'll also flip routing if they approve.

sales-jordan: I messaged them and they're okay with reducing concurrency. Approve routing to 2k quant as fallback.

eng-jun: I'll push a routing override for the account to prefer alpha-2k-quant with immediate effect and enable cross-region failover to us-east as fallback. Also attaching a small diag command — can you run this while load is active and paste output? ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/requests/metrics?acct=brightbank | jq '.pools[] | select(.name=="burstpool-us-west")'```

sales-jordan: They ran it, output attached in DM — core stats showed pool_util=100% queued=900ms.

matt: From product/ops side — if BrightBank expects sustained load we should propose a Dedicated trial (reserved burst capacity) — that will remove burstpool contention. I'll loop in AM for pricing. For the demo we can do routing fallback and client changes.

nina: Follow-up for eng: consider reducing scale_cooldown to 30s for POC accounts or add emergency_burst +1 nodes for flagged deals to avoid hitting max so fast.

eng-jun: Agree, I'll open an infra change request for a temporary emergency_burst flag for sales POCs. For now: routing override done, client concurrency reduced, and retries enabled. Monitoring — please confirm if 503s stop.

support-elaine: Noted. Jordan, keep me posted. If 503s persist after these mitigations we'll collect full request traces and escalate to infra oncall for manual pool expansion.

sales-jordan: Update: after routing override + concurrency drop errors dropped to 2 in the last 10m. Demo green. Thanks team! :tada:

matt: Filing follow-up action items: pricing follow-up + Dedicated offer, product note about POC defaults, and ops task for emergency_burst policy.

eng-jun: Adding one diagnostic note: if you see recurring kv-cache pressure errors, ask customer to reduce streaming token window (shorter chunk sizes) — that reduces memory and cache hits.

support-elaine: Closing thread for now, will reopen if anything else. :white_check_mark:
